answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The sable edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 116 clones produces a signature the pulse analysis flags immediately. An attacker must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the comet settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
